baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative قُمِ governs ٱلَّيْلَ and is narrowed by the exceptive إِلَّا قَلِيلًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily rising is extended across the night as a duration, while the exception removes only a small portion from that span.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily rising gives قُمِ its literal posture and initiates the vigil.
Night and its darkness supply the temporal field over which the rising persists.
Fewness makes the excepted remainder narrow rather than making the vigil itself brief.

changed_reading.before: Rise at some point during the night.
changed_reading.after: Sustain an upright vigil through nearly the whole night, withholding only a small portion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُمِ can name undertaking a matter as well as changing bodily posture, and ٱلَّيْلَ is the domain of that undertaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command commissions a resolved nocturnal occupation; the small exception bounds a sustained task rather than a single act of getting up.

activation_trace.role: Resolve and rising to undertake a matter turn قُمِ into deliberate commitment.
Doing or entering an activity by night makes the night an active work period.
The small exception sets the undertaking's narrow release interval.

changed_reading.after: Commit yourself to a sustained night undertaking, except for a limited remainder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The standing-place branch of ق و م can spatialize the temporal object ٱلَّيْلَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The night becomes a station in which the addressee remains, with only a small interval spent outside it.

activation_trace.role: Station, standing-place, and residence recast standing as sustained emplacement.
Night supplies the temporal territory metaphorically occupied as a station.
Fewness limits the interval outside the nocturnal station.

changed_reading.before: Remain awake for most of the night.
changed_reading.after: Make the night itself your station, departing from it only briefly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding wrapped bodily state gives the imperative a visible reversal: enclosure and repose open into exposed upright action.

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising supplies the destination posture of the transition.
Wrapping oneself in clothing supplies the enclosed starting posture from which قُمِ releases the addressee.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding vocative identifies the commanded addressee through a wrapped bodily condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrappedness followed by bodily rising; I infer a reversal from enclosure to exposure, while the live alternative is that the epithet identifies the addressee without staging posture.

changed_reading.before: Begin a night vigil from an unspecified condition.
changed_reading.after: Unwrap the body's settled enclosure into upright nocturnal readiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Half, subtraction, repeated smallness, and addition resolve the vague exception into an adjustable measured band around a substantial portion of the night.

activation_trace.role: Fewness initially leaves the excepted duration comparatively open.
The half or one of two portions supplies the central measurable share.
Removal of part of a thing supplies downward adjustment from the stated share.
Repeated fewness constrains the downward adjustment to a small amount.
Increase and growth supply the corresponding upward adjustment.

structural_cues: 73:3-4 expands the exceptive duration through the alternatives half, subtract a little, or add.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a half plus bounded decrease and increase; I infer that these specify an elastic range for 73:2, while the alternative is that they are discrete options rather than a continuum.

changed_reading.before: Stand for nearly the whole night except an unspecified little.
changed_reading.after: Work within a deliberately adjustable night measure centered on a substantial share rather than a rigid all-but-little quota.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nocturnal undertaking becomes a temporal scaffold for gathering recited material and arranging it in distinct, ordered sequence.

activation_trace.role: Resolved undertaking supplies the sustained work frame rather than a momentary posture.
Ordered arrangement and laying things in sequence supply the work's pacing and articulation.
Gathering and collection make recitation an act of assembling material within the night.

structural_cues: The duration instructions flow directly into the paired imperative and verbal noun وَرَتِّلِ ... تَرْتِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nocturnal undertaking, collection, and ordered arrangement; I infer that standing furnishes their temporal scaffold, while the alternative is simple succession of independent commands.

changed_reading.before: Use most of the night for an unspecified vigil.
changed_reading.after: Occupy the night as the workspace in which revelation is gathered, spaced, and ordered in recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Standing becomes load-bearing formation: a supporting practice that prepares the addressee to receive and carry a coming utterance presented as weight.

activation_trace.role: Support, mainstay, and that by which something remains standing make the vigil a load-bearing structure.
Receiving speech by taking and learning it supplies the transfer that the standing must bear.
Spoken utterance identifies the transferred load as communicative speech.
Making a burden heavy supplies the pressure for which nocturnal support is formed.

structural_cues: 73:5 places the future delivery of a heavy word upon the addressee immediately after the standing and recitation instructions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, reception, utterance, and heaviness; I infer a preparatory arrow from vigil to carrying capacity, while the live alternative is that the heavy word is merely the later task rather than the vigil's cause.

changed_reading.before: Standing is an arduous devotional demand.
changed_reading.after: Standing constructs the support needed to receive and carry an utterance whose weight is about to descend upon the addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The night's arising links intensified footing or congruence to straighter utterance, so the focus standing becomes an alignment practice joining bodily emplacement and speech.

activation_trace.role: Straightness, uprightness, and evenness expose an alignment potential inside the focus imperative.
Approach, rising, and coming make the night itself an arising event that answers قُمِ.
Intense strength and solidity supply the heightened force of the nocturnal condition.
One thing corresponding with another supplies congruence between the standing body and what it voices.
The repeated root's straightness branch transfers uprightness from posture into the quality of speech.
Vocalized utterance supplies the output that nocturnal alignment straightens.

structural_cues: 73:6 predicates both أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا and أَقْوَمُ قِيلًا of the arising of night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night-rising, intensified waṭʾ, and straighter utterance; I infer a body-to-speech alignment system, while the alternative reading takes waṭʾ as difficulty or pressure without congruence.

changed_reading.after: Standing at night aligns embodied footing with a more upright and stable utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stationary night is a counterweight to the opened, fluid, and extended movement of the day; nocturnal emplacement calibrates daytime dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Station and residence supply a stable nocturnal emplacement.
Day's opening through light supplies the contrasting temporal field.
Running and swimming supply the day's fluid, mobile mode.
Long duration stretches that daytime movement against the night's station.

structural_cues: 73:7 explicitly contrasts the night sequence with a long sabḥ located in the day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a night station and long daytime swimming; I infer a stabilizing counterweight between them, while the alternative is only a practical scheduling contrast.

changed_reading.before: The night is selected because it is free time.
changed_reading.after: The night is a fixed station that prevents the day's long fluid movement from becoming total dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human act of standing over the night is nested under a keeper to whom the whole affair is handed, replacing solitary self-maintenance with delegated custodianship.

activation_trace.role: Care, guardianship, and persevering maintenance make قُمِ a human custodial action.
Handing an affair to another removes the vigil from a frame of self-sufficiency.
One who stands over an affair with sufficient care mirrors and contains the focus root's guardianship image.

structural_cues: After naming the Lord of east and west, 73:9 commands the addressee to take Him as wakīl.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human maintenance and a sufficient keeper entrusted with the affair; I infer nested agency, while the alternative is that reliance addresses later opposition and does not redefine the vigil.

changed_reading.before: Maintain the night vigil by personal resolve.
changed_reading.after: Keep the night faithfully while entrusting the larger affair to the keeper whose care contains your own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated قَلِيلًا binds two bounded intervals: the small release from standing and the small delay granted to deniers, making limited time carry both accommodation and urgency.

activation_trace.role: Fewness marks the vigil's narrow excepted interval.
The same fewness image marks the deniers' narrow remaining delay.
Deliberateness and absence of haste make that second little span a controlled respite.

structural_cues: The identical surface قَلِيلًا closes both 73:2 and 73:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical echo across two limited intervals; I infer a shared countdown structure, while the alternative is a rhythmic refrain with no interpretive transfer.

changed_reading.before: The small exception is simply leniency within a demanding vigil.
changed_reading.after: The small exception is merciful room inside a surah where every remaining interval is also urgent and finite.

context_deltas.mechanism: Observed standing varies across people and fractions, divine measure exceeds human enumeration, and accessible performance responds to impaired capacity; the initial command is therefore calibrated rather than stopwatch-rigid.

activation_trace.role: The focus exception provides the original opening for bounded accommodation.
Actual bodily standing and the later establishment command show the focus practice embodied under revised conditions.
Measured governance by deliberation assigns the night its true proportions beyond private estimation.
Exhaustive numerical counting identifies the precision the community cannot sustain.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the replacement criterion of feasible performance.
Weakening and restricted movement make bodily capacity a concrete reason for calibration.

structural_cues: 73:20 reports varying night fractions and a group standing with the addressee, then states inability to enumerate and twice directs recitation of what is feasible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies varied performance, divine measuring, failed enumeration, ease, and illness; I infer that these calibrate 73:2 by capacity, while the alternative is that 73:20 legally replaces rather than interprets the earlier command.

changed_reading.before: Nearly the whole night is a uniform quota measured by each performer.
changed_reading.after: The command establishes serious night practice whose realizable measure is divinely known and responsively scaled to human capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because provisioning comes from the non-dominant ز ي د to ز و د split rather than the ordinary increase branch; it remains anchored in the focus undertaking and the packet's mapped branch, but downstream prose should present added night as journey-provision by analogy, not translate زِدْ as provision.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُمِ supplies an undertaking and ٱلَّيْلَ its work period; the context's split branch lets added time function as carried provision for that undertaking.

activation_trace.role: Resolve and undertaking provide the onward task for which provision can be gathered.
Night activity supplies the period from which the metaphorical provision is drawn.
Carrying provisions for a journey makes the added nocturnal portion usable sustenance for what follows.

changed_reading.before: Adding to the night changes only the amount of time spent.
changed_reading.after: The added nocturnal portion can be carried forward as provision for the undertaking ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading moves from bodily-moral uprightness to geology, which is surprising; the focus root and the packet's later disturbance, solidity, and pouring images keep the analogy traceable, but prose should call it anticipatory resonance rather than claim that 73:2 directly predicts the scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The uprightness branch of قُمِ supplies a maintained vertical order that can be contrasted with the later loss of terrestrial and mountainous stability.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and uprightness supply the stable human posture carried into the contrast.
Severe disturbance removes stability from the earth beneath the standing figure.
Raised solid mass supplies the apparent structural support that will fail.
Poured, cascading material converts solid mountain support into unstable flow.

changed_reading.before: Stand upright during the night as a private bodily discipline.
changed_reading.after: Practice an uprightness able to persist in imagination even when the world's seemingly upright supports tremble and pour away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because valuation is a form-distant ق و م branch and the economic mechanism is analogical; it remains focus-anchored through that branch and is reinforced by advance, repayable loan, and recompense cues, but it should never replace the primary bodily or devotional sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The value and appraisal branch of قُمِ allows the costly night standing to be viewed as value established and advanced rather than time merely lost.

activation_trace.role: Value, appraisal, and pricing expose an economic potential within the focus root.
A cut of wealth or work whose recompense returns supplies the investment mechanism.
Advancing forward makes present effort something sent ahead.
Recompense for work supplies the later return on what the night standing advances.

changed_reading.before: Night standing spends scarce rest in the present.
changed_reading.after: Night standing establishes value in the present that is advanced toward a later finding and recompense.

strongest_changes: The wrapped addressee makes قُمِ a bodily reversal from enclosure into upright readiness.
The vague small exception becomes an adjustable measured band and finally a capacity-sensitive practice governed beyond exhaustive human counting.
Standing becomes support for receiving a heavy utterance and an alignment mechanism joining footing to straighter speech.
The night station counterbalances long daytime movement, while divine custodianship contains rather than cancels human resolve.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly redistributed ق و م across posture, undertaking, station, support, straightness, care, and even valuation without detaching those readings from قُمِ; the exact echo of قَلِيلًا and the non-dominant ز و د mapping produced additional temporal and provisioning activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal accusative may sustain only duration, leaving station and custodial readings metaphorical rather than syntactic.
Several preparation and counterweight arrows come from sequence and contrast; the same verses can remain adjacent instructions without those causal links.
73:20 may calibrate the initial command, supersede its earlier scope, or report a separate communal settlement.
The provisioning, geophysical, and valuation outliers depend on explicitly qualified analogical transfer.
